title: Hunting Gold in London's Underground Sewers
hook: Toshers waded into miles of underground brick tunnels for dropped jewelry.

scenes.text: Beneath the streets of Victorian London lay a pitch-black labyrinth of hundreds of miles of brick sewer tunnels.

scenes.text: Daring scavengers known as 'toshers' slipped through street iron grates armed with canvas bags, lanterns, and iron hoe scrapers.

scenes.text: They waded through waist-deep sludge, sifting muck between bricks to find dropped gold rings, silver coins, silver spoons, and jewelry.
